unlisted_practices: Conduct prospective, randomized studies of AI tools that measure patient-oriented and health-system-focused outcomes.
Encourage multicenter, multinational collaborations to build high-quality datasets that improve the generalizability of AI tools.
Adhere to reporting guidelines such as CONSORT-AI and TRIPOD and register and publish AI trial results to reduce publication bias.
Regulatory agencies should establish and enforce unified, phased evidence standards for AI tools modeled on drug approval.
Educate patients and clinicians on best practices for using generative AI tools safely.
Rigorously evaluate synthetic data for fidelity, equitability, and bias before using it to train AI models.
Prospectively validate digital twin models to ensure their predictions are accurate.
